T0581.title: Runtime Protection
T0581.definition: Controls that detect or resist tampering, hooking, debugging, emulation, and runtime manipulation.
T0581.description: Runtime protection detects debugging, injection, hooking, emulation, tampering, and memory manipulation while an app runs. It does not replace server-side risk controls, but it raises the cost of mobile cheating, reverse engineering, and automation. Reviews should cover bypass difficulty, false positives, signal reporting, and server-side policy linkage.
T0581.usageExample: Assess Runtime Protection related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
